fault_notes: The agent never paraphrases Eleanor's login problem to confirm understanding, repeatedly asks for details she has already provided, including her device, email address, and the error message, and responds impatiently and condescendingly when she becomes frustrated. The agent offers basic app troubleshooting but does not demonstrate effective listening or professional rapport. [On saving, four unlisted faults added: noname (the agent never says "Eleanor" or "Hughes"); empathy (the customer falls to -72 and the agent never acknowledges the feeling, only "no need to get annoyed" / "no need to be dramatic"); ownership ("I'm not the app development team", then sends her to the app support team and the online form); noconfirm (she still cannot log in when the call ends).]

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Daniel. I'm having trouble logging into the S-Net app. It keeps rejecting me even though I'm using the password I normally use.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you tried uninstalling the app and installing it again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Not yet. I thought I'd call first because I don't want to lose anything or make the problem worse.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's just an app. Removing it shouldn't be a big deal. Anyway, what's the email address on your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's eleanor.hughes@example.com.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And which email address are you using to log in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The same one I just gave you, eleanor.hughes@example.com.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right. I need to verify the account before I can go any further. What's the security answer registered on it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's Bristol.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's verified. Now, what device are you using?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An iPhone 15. I've got the latest version of iOS installed as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry, which phone are you using again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An iPhone 15. I just mentioned that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, well, I deal with lots of calls. What exactly does the app say when you try to log in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says, 'We couldn't sign you in. Please check your details and try again.' I've checked them several times.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what message are you getting? Is it saying the password is wrong?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just read it to you. It says it couldn't sign me in and to check my details. It doesn't specifically say the password is wrong.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right, there's no need to get annoyed. These things take time. Have you tried resetting your password?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I haven't reset it yet. I can do that, but I'm worried it might be something wrong with the app itself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The simplest thing is to reset the password. Open the login screen and tap 'Forgot password'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I've tapped it. It's asking me to enter my email address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Enter the email address you use for your S-Net account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Done. It's the same address I gave you earlier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right. Now, which email address did you enter?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Eleanor dot Hughes at example dot com. This is the third time I've given you that address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You don't need to count how many times you've said it. Just follow the instructions on the screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm trying to. It says an email has been sent, but nothing has arrived yet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Check your junk folder. Password emails often end up there.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've checked junk and spam. There's nothing from S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then wait a little longer. Emails don't always arrive instantly. You could also check your inbox again later.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. It's been about five minutes since I started trying this. I really need to access my account today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, waiting is part of the process. There's not much point checking every few seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not checking every few seconds. I'm explaining that I need to get into the app to manage my broadband account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can use the website for account management. The app isn't the only way to do things.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know there's a website, but I prefer using the app. I just want to understand why the login isn't working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you tried closing the app completely and opening it again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I did that before I called. I've also restarted my phone once.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, but try closing it again now. Make sure it isn't running in the background.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've closed it. I'm opening it again, and I'm still getting the same message.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then the app may need reinstalling. Delete it, download it again, and try signing in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Before I do that, can you check whether there's a problem with the S-Net app or my account? I don't want to keep trying random things.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm not the app development team. We don't investigate every login issue from this desk, so reinstalling is the sensible option.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not asking you to develop the app. I'm asking for support with an S-Net service that isn't letting me sign in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And I've told you what to try. If you don't want to reinstall it, that's up to you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's a bit unfair. I've followed your instructions, and the password email hasn't arrived. Can you check if my account is locked?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't tell from the information you've given me. Are you sure you're entering the correct email address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. Eleanor dot Hughes at example dot com. You've got it on the account in front of you, and I've entered it correctly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fine. And just to confirm, which phone are you using again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An iPhone 15. I've told you that twice now. Are you actually writing any of this down?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There's no need to be dramatic. I can only work with what you're telling me, and repeating yourself won't make the app work any faster.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm frustrated because you're asking me the same questions instead of checking anything. I expected a little more help than this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Look, I've already given you the basic steps. If you keep arguing about them, we're not going to get anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not arguing. I'm asking you to help me with the login problem. The app still won't let me in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can reinstall the app, wait for the password email, or use the website. Those are the options I've provided.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The email still hasn't arrived, and I haven't been able to log in. Is there someone who can look into this properly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You could try contacting the app support team through the website. They may be able to give you more specific advice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Isn't this the S-Net support line? I thought you could at least check my account or raise an issue for the app team.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This is the general support line. We can't handle every technical issue directly, so you'll need to use the online contact form.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't think that's a reasonable answer. I've spent almost eleven minutes on the phone and I'm no closer to getting into my account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, I can't magically fix it. You have the steps, and the next move is yours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could you at least make a note that the password reset email never arrived and that I couldn't sign in?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can add a general note that you called about the app. It won't necessarily speed anything up, though.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do that. I don't want to have to explain the whole thing again if I call back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added a note saying you had trouble with the app login. You can use the website for now and contact the app team if needed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I'm still unable to log in, and the reset email hasn't come through. I'm going to have to try another route.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's probably best. Is there anything else you need?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.
